label: AS4610-54P PoE 1G open switch
description: Edgecore AS4610-54P 1RU bare-metal L3 PoE switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, all PoE (802.3af/at, 8 of them UPoE at 60 W) on a 1650 W budget, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 1x 1G RJ-45 management port and a serial console, plus 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking ports that are not modelled as data ports. 128 Gbps switching capacity, 191 Mpps, 99.1 W maximum system power without PoE load. ONIE only. End of life 30 June 2025.

poe.note: 1650 W PoE power budget for 48 ports, from the AS4610 series specification table (802.3af 15 W on 48 ports, 802.3at 30 W on 48 ports, UPoE 60 W on 8 ports). The model datasheet is explicit that the AC PSUs are redundant for the system and the network but not fully redundant for PoE functions or the power budget, so 1650 W is a single-supply figure - and 8 x 60 W plus 40 x 30 W (1680 W) would already exceed it.

fabric.note: 128 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (48 x 1G + 4 x 10G + 2 x 20G) and the figure on the product page and in the series table. The AS4610-54P R08 model datasheet prints 256 Gbps full duplex with a 190 Mpps forwarding rate; 256 Gbps counts every port in both directions, so 128 Gbps is recorded.

notes: Port count from the vendor datasheet: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE RJ-45, 4x SFP+ (10G or 1G), 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking.Broadcom BCM56340 Helix4 with a dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 at 1 GHz, 2 GB DDR3 SDRAM with ECC, 8 MB SPI flash, 4 MB shared packet buffer, 96 K MAC addresses, 4 K VLANs, 12 KB jumbo frames, two redundant hot-swappable AC PSUs (100-240 VAC), 1RU 44 x 35 x 4.4 cm. Ships as bare metal with ONIE, no NOS installed. The two QSFP+ stacking cages are described but not declared as interfaces: 20G is not a line rate the importer accepts, and calling them 40G QSFP+ or 10G would state a rate no datasheet gives. The PoE models add a fixed system fan and the front panel diagram calls out the 8 UPoE ports as one block, but the datasheet does not say which numbered ports they are, so every copper port is modelled at 30 W and the 60 W ports are recorded here rather than guessed. End of life effective 30 June 2025 (https://www.edge-core.com/eol-notice/2025-june-eol-notice-as4610-series/). Sources: product page https://www.edge-core.com/product/as4610-54p/ and the AS4610-54P R08 datasheet https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54P-R08.pdf, series figures from https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54T-R09.pdf.
